component.name: Flint Plus
component.summary: Fast, private web browser with adblock, BitTorrent and media tools

description.p: Flint is a fast, private desktop web browser by Dhiva Labs with ad and tracker blocking, secure DNS, turbo downloads and reader mode built in, and zero telemetry.
Flint Plus adds a BitTorrent client and a media grabber to everything the standard edition has.

ul.li: Ad and tracker blocking with EasyList and EasyPrivacy, applied at the network level
Secure DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS) with a choice of resolvers
Turbo downloads: a multi-connection downloader with pause and resume
Reader mode, private windows, HTTPS-first browsing and session restore
